name: Case Forwarding Notification 3 Code
definition: Specifies the action requested when forwarding a case.

FTHI.name: Further Investigation
FTHI.definition: Case has been forwarded to the next party for further investigation.

CANC.name: Request To Cancel
CANC.definition: Case has been forwarded to the next party for cancellation.

MODI.name: Request To Modify
MODI.definition: Case has been forwarded to the next party for modification.

DTAU.name: Request Debit Authorisation
DTAU.definition: Case has been forwarded to obtain authorisation to debit.

SAIN.name: Sent Additional Information
SAIN.definition: Additional information has been forwarded to the creditor.

MINE.name: Mine Investigation Case
MINE.definition: Case is been handled by the assigned party.
